items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: My oldest brother, Tom, never did become a professional pianist.

ctx.x: And all of my brothers played. There were four boys and we all four played. My oldest brother, Tom, never did become a professional pianist. He played nice piano, but he couldn't keep time with an eight-day alarm clock.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: He got me over to New Orleans, and after that, I didn't care.

ctx.x: Well, no wonder you got a job. That got you in right away.
He got me over to New Orleans, and after that, I didn't care. I never did like Whirlines. I never was crazy about Whirlines. Sidney Bechet.
Mm-hmm. This is the Second Line magazine. Yeah. May 1953. Meet Jaffer.
